findings.message: Every observed policy leaves script sources absent or broadly allowed.
findings.recommendation: Review wildcard, scheme-wide, and data script sources; prefer narrowly scoped sources or nonce/hash policies.

findings.message: The evaluated script source lists do not restrict JavaScript string evaluation; other restrictions may still apply.
findings.recommendation: Constrain script-src and remove unsafe-eval when the application can support it.

findings.message: The evaluated script source lists permit arbitrary inline script elements; other restrictions may still apply.
findings.recommendation: Use a tested nonce or hash based script policy; avoid relying on unsafe-inline.

findings.message: Every frame-ancestors directive includes a wildcard.
findings.recommendation: Set an explicit embedding policy; enforcing frame-ancestors overrides X-Frame-Options in modern browsers.
Evaluate HSTS deployment after ensuring this host supports HTTPS consistently.

findings.message: The final recognized Referrer-Policy can send full paths and queries cross-origin.
findings.recommendation: Consider strict-origin-when-cross-origin or a more restrictive policy.

findings.message: Cookie #1 lacks HttpOnly; this can be intentional for script-readable cookies.
findings.recommendation: Use HttpOnly for session cookies that client-side scripts do not need to read.
